'''Giorgi (Goga) Khachidze''' ({{lang-ka|გიორგი ხაჩიძე}}; born 9 February 1974) is a [[Politics of Georgia (country)|Georgian politician]] who served as the [[Ministry of Environment Protection and Natural Resources (Georgia)|Minister of Environment Protection and Natural Resources of Georgia]] from 2008 to 2012.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.government.gov.ge/index.php?lang_id=ENG&sec_id=124&mod_id=0&info_id=0&new_year=0&limit=0&date=&new_month=&entrant=1 |title=Government of Georgia |accessdate=2011-03-30 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110717122413/http://www.government.gov.ge/index.php?lang_id=ENG |archivedate=2011-07-17 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://moe.gov.ge/index.php?lang_id=ENG&sec_id=7 |title=Ministry of Environment Protection and Natural Resources. George Khachidze |accessdate=2011-03-30}}</ref>

==Early years==
Khachidze was born on 9 February 1974. In 1992 he entered [[Tbilisi State University]] graduating from Department of Biology, Physiology of Plants in 1997. Starting from 1993, he also studied Journalism at the same university obtaining his second Bachelor's degree in Journalism in 1997.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.finchannel.com/Main_News/Geo/64383_Postgraduate_Degrees_and_the_Government_/ |title=Postgraduate Degrees and the Government |publisher=Financial |author=Kate Chkhikvadze |date=2010-06-07 |accessdate=2011-03-30 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20111006202056/http://www.finchannel.com/Main_News/Geo/64383_Postgraduate_Degrees_and_the_Government_/ |archivedate=2011-10-06 }}</ref> From 1994 until 2002, he worked for the Channel 1 and 2 of the Georgian State Television, [[Rustavi 2]], Ibervizia, 202, 105 broadcasting companies and the Press Service of the [[Ministry of Defense (Georgia)|Ministry of Defense of Georgia]].<ref name=Geo>{{cite web |url=http://geodatabase.posterous.com/khachidze-giorgi |title=Geodatabase. Khachidze Giorgi |accessdate=2011-03-30}}</ref>

==Political career==
In November 2002, Khachidze was elected head of ''United Democrats'' political party in [[Khashuri]]. From November 2003 through March 2004, he was the Deputy Head of Executive Power of [[Khashuri District]]. From March 2004 until December 2004, he was member of [[Parliament of Georgia]]. In December 2004, he was appointed State Attorney for [[Mtskheta-Mtianeti]] district by the [[President of Georgia]]. In March 2005, he was reassigned with the same duties to [[Samtskhe-Javakheti]] district where he remained until November 2008. On 1 November 2008 Khachidze was appointed Minister of Environment Protection and Natural Resources of Georgia.<ref name=Geo/> He resigned in August 2012 in order to run for the October 1 [[Georgian legislative election, 2012|parliamentary election]].<ref>[http://civil.ge/eng/article.php?id=25170 Environment Minister Resigns to Run for MP]. Civil Georgia. September 1, 2012.</ref> He served in the Parliament for the [[United National Movement (Georgia)|United National Movement]] until quitting the party in May 2015.<ref>{{cite news|title=Four MPs Quit UNM Opposition Party|url=http://civil.ge/eng/article.php?id=28297|accessdate=26 May 2015|work=Civil Georgia|date=25 May 2015}}</ref> He founded [[New Political Centre – Girchi|Girchi]] together with [[Zurab Japaridze]] in the same year.

Khachidze is fluent in Russian and English.<ref name=Geo/>
